title: finance-legal-scratchpad-2026-03-02
content:
Personal finance/legal scratchpad - quick actionable list

Top priorities:
- [ ] CloudScale invoice INV-2026-003 ($24,800) due 2026-03-15
    * Verify PO 98724 and GL coding (capex vs opex)
    * Email AP (ap@redwood.com) and cc Samir Patel; ask for amortization schedule
- [ ] DataSafe SaaS Agreement (DSA-2025) redline
    * Ask: narrow data processing, add customer-managed KMS language, limit log retention to 90 days
    * Push for appended subprocessor schedule vs "available on request"
    * Change liability cap wording to "aggregate fees paid in prior 12 months"
    * Draft redline -> Priya review -> send to vendor by 2026-03-04
- [ ] Renewals within 60 days:
    * Auth0 renewal 2026-04-10 -> request usage report + cost forecast (Owner: Samir)
    * Monitoring tool auto-renew 2026-04-01 -> check seat counts, negotiate discount
    * Office lease Floor 6 notice 2026-05-30 -> flag to Ops and CFO

Other items:
- Approve Zoom rooms hardware ($3,200) -> add to PO queue
- Pending refund: Vendor X ticket #824 -> AP to confirm credit memo
- PayrollCo INV-3321 shows duplicate contractor bonus line -> ask HR to confirm

Communications/refs:
- Slack #finance-ops thread "invoices-q1" (see flagged messages)
- Confluence: finance/purchase-requests -> update "invoice note" field
- Contract templates PR: github.com/redwood-inference/contract-templates/pull/12 -> hold until liability clause updated

Suggested redline language for DataSafe:
- "Vendor shall provide written notice at least 30 days before engaging any new subprocessor and allow Customer to object for reasonable security/compliance grounds."
- "Customer may configure and manage encryption keys; Vendor will not have access to plaintext or key material without explicit authorization."
- Breach notification: 48 hours initial + 7 day detailed report

This week's mini-schedule:
- Wed 2026-03-03: Draft redline, send to Priya for review (EOD)
- Thu 2026-03-04: Send redline to vendor, include procurement contact (Samir)
- Fri 2026-03-05: Reconcile CloudScale invoice and submit AP approval

Notes to self:
- Keep copies of contract versions in legal drive folder with version notes
- If vendor resists liability cap change, escalate to CFO for commercial exception
- Save standard clause snippets to snippets.doc for faster future redlines

Quick refs: PO 98724, INV-2026-003, DSA-2025, JIRA-4521

End of scratchpad.
__notes: Informal personal scratchpad. Will migrate items to Jira/Confluence once actioned.
